messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "relaxing the muscle in the prostate and bladder neck"
set: ["relaxing the muscle in the prostate and bladder neck", "blocking alpha-1 receptors in the prostate and bladder neck", "relaxing and widening the blood vessels", "reducing the production of uric acid in the body", "relaxes muscles in the airways", "calming overactive nerve signals in the brain and nervous system", "calming overactive electrical signals in the brain and nervous system", "reducing nerve signals in the brain", "reduces sugar production in the liver", "stimulates insulin production in the pancreas", "making the kidneys pass more salt and water out of the body", "increasing serotonin activity in the brain", "increasing the amounts of serotonin and norepinephrine", "affects chemicals in the brain and nerves that contribute to hyperactivity and impulse control", "restoring balance of serotonin in the brain", "blocking the acid pump in your stomach"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
